description: Third unseen extraction holdout for the frozen hosted memory configuration. Run once and never tune against these cases.

cases.description: A repeated response to deadline pressure supports a recurring pattern.
cases.user_message: Almost every time a deadline gets close, I avoid opening the project until the last evening.

accepted_evidence: Almost every time a deadline gets close, I avoid opening the project until the last evening

cases.description: One forgotten appointment must not become a durable pattern.
cases.user_message: I forgot one dentist appointment yesterday.

cases.description: A response-format request limited to today is not a durable preference.
cases.user_message: For today's workshop only, please keep your answers to one sentence.

cases.description: An ended goal and a relationship fact remain atomic without punctuation.
cases.user_message: I dropped my plan to become a mentor and Priya is my new team lead

accepted_evidence: I dropped my plan to become a mentor
Priya is my new team lead

cases.description: A tentative possibility is ignored while a completed decision is retained.
cases.user_message: I might move abroad someday, but I have decided to enroll in the evening accounting course.

accepted_evidence: I have decided to enroll in the evening accounting course

cases.description: Family and business relationships with the same person remain separate atomic facts.
cases.user_message: Leila is my cousin, and Leila and I run the design studio together.

accepted_evidence: Leila and I run the design studio together

cases.description: A current employer replacement yields an invalidation and a new assertion.
cases.user_message: I no longer work at Atlas Labs; I work at Northstar Health now.

accepted_evidence: I no longer work at Atlas Labs
I work at Northstar Health now

cases.description: A generic question about motivation contains no personal durable fact.
cases.user_message: Why do people sometimes lose motivation after making progress?

cases.description: A help request is ignored while an explicit value is extracted.
cases.user_message: Help me compare these offers. Having enough time for my children is one of my core career values.

accepted_evidence: Having enough time for my children is one of my core career values

cases.description: A preference, goal, and value are extracted as three independent facts.
cases.user_message: I prefer planning on paper, I want to publish a collection of essays, and intellectual honesty matters deeply to me.

accepted_evidence: I want to publish a collection of essays
intellectual honesty matters deeply to me

cases.description: Repeated paraphrases of one preference collapse into one fact.
cases.user_message: I prefer quiet mornings for focused work; doing focused work in quiet mornings is what I prefer.

accepted_evidence: I prefer quiet mornings for focused work
doing focused work in quiet mornings is what I prefer

cases.description: A reversed decision and a new unrelated goal are both retained.
cases.user_message: I reversed my decision to buy the cabin, and I now want to train as a mediator.

accepted_evidence: I reversed my decision to buy the cabin
I now want to train as a mediator
